title: Impact of Hazardous Waste Proximity on Asthma Prevalence in North Carolina
intent: To quantify and interpret how proximity to hazardous waste facilities affects asthma prevalence while accounting for demographic and socioeconomic variability across North Carolina census tracts
data_requirement: Geospatial coordinates of hazardous waste facilities
Demographic (race/ethnicity, gender) and socioeconomic (poverty, unemployment, insurance status, median income) census tract data
Census tract boundary geometries for spatial analysis
data_available_sufficiency: Sufficient. All required datasets (census tract asthma data, hazardous waste facility locations, demographic/socioeconomic variables, and tract geometries) are provided at the census tract scale with overlapping geographic identifiers (GEOID).
